cards.text: Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, gets two pieces of news. Joshua captured Ai and did to it and its king just what he did to Jericho. And the people of Gibeon made peace with Israel and are living near them.

cards.question: Adoni-zedek and his people are greatly alarmed that Gibeon made peace with Israel. What makes Gibeon such a big deal?

answers.text: It was bigger than Ai and its men were mighty
It guarded the main road down to Egypt
It had the tallest walls in all of Canaan

cards.text: So Adoni-zedek sends word to four other kings: Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon. He basically starts a group chat, and friend, NOBODY is sending smiley faces in this one.

cards.question: Adoni-zedek's message to the kings: come help me, and together we'll attack ___, because it made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.

cards.text: So the five kings of the Amorites join forces, bring ALL their armies, camp before Gibeon and make war against it. Five kings on one city is like five bosses emailing you about the same deadline at the same time.

cards.question: Gibeon is surrounded by five armies. Who do the men of Gibeon send word to, begging for help?

answers.text: Joshua in the camp at Gilgal

cards.text: Joshua and his WHOLE army come out from Gilgal, mighty men of valor and all. Nobody hits snooze on this one.

cards.question: Joshua's army is on the move toward Gibeon. What does the LORD tell Joshua?

answers.text: Don't be afraid because I've handed them over to you
Send messengers to the five kings and talk first
Take only your mighty men and leave the rest behind

cards.question: True or false: the LORD warns Joshua that a few of the five kings will still be able to stand against him.
True or false: Joshua's army marches all night from Gilgal and catches the five kings by surprise.

cards.text: Then the LORD throws the enemy into confusion before Israel, and Israel defeats them in a great slaughter at Gibeon and chases them up to Beth-horon and as far as Azekah and Makkedah. These folks marched ALL NIGHT and then ran a chase, and I get winded hopping my base over to the oven.

cards.question: As the enemy flees down from Beth-horon to Azekah, the LORD throws down large ___ on them from the sky.
True or false: more of the enemy are killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites.
That same day, right in front of all Israel, Joshua speaks to the LORD and calls out to the sky. What does he call for?

answers.text: The sun and moon to stand still
The stars to fall on the enemy
Dark clouds to hide the whole army

cards.text: And the sun stands still, and the moon stops, until the nation takes vengeance on its enemies. Friend, I can't even get my oven timer to pause, and God just parks the SUN.

cards.question: The writer says this day is also written down in another book. Which book?

answers.text: The Book of the Wars of the LORD
The Book of the Kings of Judah

cards.question: According to that book, the sun stops in the middle of the sky and waits about a full ___ before going down.
The writer says there has never been a day like this one, before or since. What makes it one of a kind?

answers.text: The LORD listened to the voice of a man
Israel won without anyone lifting a sword
Every king in the land surrendered at once

cards.text: Then Joshua returns with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal. But don't take that apron off yet, friend, because this story isn't finished.

findings.problem: Joshua is named for the first time with no word on who he is. Adoni-zedek gets his introduction, but Joshua doesn't get one like "Joshua, Israel's leader."

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: The first sentence packs in more than two things happening: the LORD throws the enemy into confusion, Israel defeats them in a great slaughter at Gibeon, chases them up to Beth-horon, and strikes them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah. Then the joke adds another sentence. The card should be split. The confusion the LORD sends could also be set up for a choice card.

rule.text: Aim for one beat per story card. Two is the most. If a story card has more than two things happening, split it.

findings.problem: Multiple choice makes up 6 of the stop's 12 choice cards (cards 2, 6, 8, 14, 16 and 18). That is double each of the other types, with 3 true or false and 3 fill in the blank.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
